question_text: Historical Timeline: Alexander the Great was born in 356 BCE and died in 323 BCE. (a) How old was Alexander when he died? (b) How many years after 680 BCE was the year 360 BCE?
options: (a) 33 years old, (b) 320 years
By multiplying the given values by the scale factor
By calculating the perimeter using standard formulas
By finding the prime factorization of the given numbers
step_by_step_solution: (a) Age = Birth Year - Death Year = 356 - 323 = 33 years old. (b) Years elapsed = 680 - 360 = 320 years.

question_text: Which of the following inequality statements comparing negative integers is TRUE?
step_by_step_solution: On a horizontal number line, values decrease moving to the left. Since -10 lies further to the left than -3, -10 < -3.

question_text: Bank Account Overdraft: An account balance is Rs 2500. A deposit of Rs 1200 is made, followed by a withdrawal of Rs 1800. (a) What is the balance after these transactions? (b) A second withdrawal of Rs 2200 is made. Does the account go into overdraft, and by how much?
options: (a) Rs 1900, (b) Yes, overdraft of -Rs 300
By multiplying the given values by the scale factor
By calculating the perimeter using standard formulas
By finding the prime factorization of the given numbers
step_by_step_solution: (a) Balance = 2500 + 1200 - 1800 = Rs 1900. (b) After 2200 withdrawal = 1900 - 2200 = -300. Yes, the account is in overdraft by Rs 300 (-Rs 300).
